FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Il neige.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I stay in the house.
   B. It is cloudy.
   C. It is cold.
   D. It is snowing.

2. How do you write the number 1 in French? (1 mark)
   A. quinze
   B. sept
   C. trois
   D. un

3. Which little word goes with 'dos' (the back)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

4. How do you say 'the shop' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la clé
   B. le jardin
   C. le tapis
   D. le magasin

5. What does 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a cake.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. It is a banana.
   D. What is it?

6. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. I stay in the house.
   C. It is hot.
   D. It is cloudy.

7. What does 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. My name is Amina.
   C. What is your name?
   D. How do you spell it?

8. What does 'la carotte' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cheese
   B. the carrot
   C. vegetables
   D. juice

9. How do you say 'What day is it today?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   B. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   C. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   D. Demain, c'est jeudi.

10. What does 'Et toi ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. And you?
   D. How are you?

11. Which day ends in che? (1 mark)
   A. samedi
   B. dimanche
   C. lundi
   D. jeudi

12. What does 'une chanson' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a candle
   C. a month
   D. a balloon

13. What does 'la bouche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mouth
   B. the head
   C. the knee
   D. the hand

14. What does 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a table.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. Put the book in the bedroom.
   D. The cat is under the chair.

15. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'pleasant'? (1 mark)
   A. agreable
   B. agréable
   C. agréble
   D. agrèable

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'In the morning, I eat bread.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Hi, Kamau!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'The bag is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'Allez tout droit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'Thank you very much!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'Elle est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — It is snowing.
   Il neige. means It is snowing.

2. D — un
   1 in French is un.

3. B — le
   dos is masculine, so we say le dos.

4. D — le magasin
   the shop in French is le magasin.

5. D — What is it?
   Qu'est-ce que c'est ? means What is it?

6. C — It is hot.
   Il fait chaud. means It is hot.

7. C — What is your name?
   Comment tu t'appelles ? means What is your name?.

8. B — the carrot
   la carotte means the carrot.

9. B — Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   What day is it today? in French is Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?

10. C — And you?
   Et toi ? means And you?.

11. B — dimanche
   Dimanche is the only day that ends in che.

12. A — a song
   une chanson means a song.

13. A — the mouth
   la bouche means the mouth.

14. D — The cat is under the chair.
   Le chat est sous la chaise. means The cat is under the chair.

15. B — agréable
   The correct spelling is agréable, with its accents.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le matin, je mange du pain.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Salut, Kamau !
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le sac est dans la chambre.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Go straight ahead.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Merci beaucoup !
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is under the chair.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
